# Digital QR Menue

> Pakistan's first QR-based digital menu and WhatsApp ordering platform for restaurants, cafes, and food businesses across Pakistan.

## About

Digital QR Menue (Digitalmenue.com) helps Pakistani restaurants create digital QR code menus in under 5 minutes. Customers scan, browse, and order via WhatsApp — no app download needed, no commission on orders.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://www.digitalmenue.com): Pakistan's #1 QR Code Menu Platform for Restaurants
- [Browse Restaurants](https://www.digitalmenue.com/restaurants): Find restaurants with digital menus across Pakistan
- [Pricing](https://www.digitalmenue.com/pricing): Free Trial, Starter (PKR 1,200/mo), Growth (PKR 2,500/mo), Premium (PKR 4,500/mo)
- [FAQ](https://www.digitalmenue.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about QR menus and WhatsApp ordering
- [Contact](https://www.digitalmenue.com/contact): Get in touch via WhatsApp or email
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.digitalmenue.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://www.digitalmenue.com/terms)

## Features

- Digital menu with QR codes
- WhatsApp order integration
- QR code generation and management
- Analytics dashboard
- Urdu / English bilingual support
- JazzCash & Easypaisa payment integration
- Real-time order notifications
- Staff management
- Table management

## Key Facts
- Pakistan's first QR-based digital menu and WhatsApp ordering platform for restaurants
- Founded: 2024
- Served cities: Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, Faisalabad, and all Pakistan
- Pricing: Free Trial (PKR 0, 30 days), Starter (PKR 1,200/mo), Growth (PKR 2,500/mo), Premium (PKR 4,500/mo)
- Payment integration: JazzCash, Easypaisa
- Bilingual: English and Urdu
- Zero commission on all orders
- No app download needed for customers
- Works on every smartphone in Pakistan
